title: Posture and rescue presentation: bound/sleep/sit rendering, rescue dialog, announcements
player_outcome: Bound NPCs kneel tied up, the Stylist hangs in a web cocoon, the Tortured Soul looks ghostly, and the Angler sleeps on the sand. Name tags read 'Bound Goblin' and so on. Talking to them frees them with a thank-you line, and a message announces the rescue.
design: Core: add enum ResidentPosture {Stand, Sit, Sleep, Bound, Lie} and TownNpc.Posture. Bound NPCs get it from Rescue.Pose (bound/webbed/tortured → Bound; sleeping/unconscious → Lie). TownDebugCommands: 'town pose <id> <posture>' for tours.

TownRenderer: map Posture → locomotion state (sit/sleep/bound/lie) before the walk/idle logic, and keep the yaw from Core. The name tag uses DisplayTitle. Webbed: a pooled translucent cocoon (the PropLibrary cobweb model scaled around the body, or a QuadMesh sphere with the cobweb material) attached while Bound and pose webbed. Tortured: SetTint(new Color(0.6,0.8,1.3)) and SetCastShadows(false). Cocoons live in a new TownRenderer.Props.cs partial and are pooled (no per-frame allocation).

TownDialog: Open(npc) first calls TryOpenRescue(npc), a new TownDialog.Rescue.cs partial. For a bound NPC it calls Game.Town.Rescue and shows Rescue.Thanks. When RequiresItem is missing it shows 'It needs to be purified...' and a 'Purify' button that appears once the item is carried.

New game/UI/TownAnnouncer.cs node subscribes to Town.Rescued and later visitor events, and posts through Hud.Announce, or ChatLog if the UI phase added one. Make Hud.Announce public (a one-line change; Hud.cs is 373 lines, so add nothing else there).
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Town/TownSystem.Rescues.cs — set Posture on bind and clear it on rescue
files_add: game/UI/TownAnnouncer.cs — town chat and announcement messages
data_changes: rescue.thanks and title strings (Terraria-flavoured) in data/town/*.json
tests: TownTests: DisplayTitle 'Bound Goblin' while bound, 'Name the Goblin Tinkerer' after rescue; Posture Bound → Stand
Smoke rescue.cmds: replace 'town rescue' with 'ui talk goblin_tinkerer' / 'assert flag.rescued_goblin_tinkerer == 1' / 'ui close'
Tour tour.cmds: 'town bind stylist 4 0 4' + screenshot (lavapipe, main only)
verification: In game: bound goblin kneels; talking frees him; announcement plus sound
risks: TownDialog.cs is also restyled by the UI phase (chat box at top centre, text buttons). Keep rescue logic in its own partial so the restyle only touches layout.
Hud.cs is near the 400-line limit; any other Hud additions must go into new files.
